system.description:
Your magic comes from a moment of fey contact: a bargain half-remembered, a dream that lasted too long.

  • Bloodline Cantrips: Minor Illusion and Daze.
  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Once per encounter, teleport up to 30ft to any visible unoccupied space as part of your movement. You have Advantage on saves against charm and sleep, and against effects that would compel you to speak.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, for 1 minute all saves against your spells are made at Disadvantage within 60ft. Once during this window, when a creature fails a save against a spell you cast, you may cast one additional spell of 5th level or lower at that creature as part of the same action, expending its slot.
